interpretation: Measured values only: no Sim prediction or residual is included.
Every observation is joined to current Body by source SHA plus q/B/M and exact Forward count.
Effective service calibration is allowed for an explicit operator/payload regime; this input does not estimate pure link bandwidth from elapsed.
GLM routing full native ABI groups are retained. Qwen conv/recurrent complete active-contract populations are explicitly narrower than native ABI.
HCOM COMMUNICATION envelopes and AIV tasks are distinct from typed AI_CPU controllers; no controller waits or duplicate HCOM summaries are added.
